props.description:
When you cast an【⚡Offensive Spell】 targeting a single creature, if the spell has a total Mind Point cost of 【SL × 10】 or lower and you have one or more bow, brawling, dagger, flail, spear or sword weapons equipped, you may choose one of those weapons. If you do, your Magic Check for the spell will use the chosen weapon's Accuracy Check formula

For instance, the Magic Check for an Elementalist spell cast through a 【bronze sword】 will be 【DEX + MIG】 +1 instead of 【INS + WLP】.
